newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran quake death toll now 600 - Red Crescent.
newsitem.headline: Iran quake death toll now 600 - Red Crescent.

text.p: The head of Iran's Red Crescent Society on Monday raised to 600 the death toll in an earthquake which struck the country's northwest on Friday and said more than 2,500 others had been injured.
Seifollah Vahid Dastjerdi, giving the latest figures to reporters in Tehran, expressed satisfaction with the pace of relief operations in Ardabil province on Iran's border with Azerbaijan.
Friday's quake, which struck the largely rural region with a magnitude of 5.5 degrees on the Richter scale, left 35,000 people homeless.

A Red Crescent official on Monday told Reuters a second earthquake measuring 5.2 on the Richter scale that hit the same area on Sunday night had caused casualties, but that it was not yet clear how many.

Dastjerdi, quoted by Iran's official news agency IRNA, said that so far more than 8,700 tents, 21,800 blankets, 15,300 heaters and lanterns, 2,000 cans of baby formula and 80 tonnes of bread had been distributed to the victims.
He said Switzerland, Britain, Japan and some international relief organisations had offered to help the victims.
